name: @findlocal/mcp
description: FindLocal Events MCP server — curated local-event data as OAuth-gated, metered MCP tools over D1.

scripts.kv:create: wrangler kv namespace create OAUTH_KV && wrangler kv namespace create USAGE_KV
scripts.seed:customers: wrangler kv key put --binding USAGE_KV "customer:demo-pro" "{\"plan\":\"pro\",\"monthly_quota\":10000,\"active\":true}" && wrangler kv key put --binding USAGE_KV "customer:demo-free" "{\"plan\":\"free\",\"monthly_quota\":100,\"active\":true}"
